generators.carrier: n=5 qubit Pauli group mod phase, GF(2)^10
commutation with the 4 stabilizer generators of the [[5,1,3]] code
quotient of normalizer by stabilizer, Z2^2

relations.statement: The normalizer of the stabilizer group has 2^6=64 elements modulo phase; the stabilizer has 16, giving 4 logical classes
relations.hypotheses: stabilizer generated by XZZXI and its cyclic shifts

relations.statement: Every nontrivial normalizer element not in the stabilizer has weight at least 3
relations.hypotheses: exhaustive GF(2) check over the 64 normalizer elements

relations.statement: For each of the 10 triples T and each nontrivial logical class c, there exists a normalizer element in class c supported within T

lemmas.statement: No pair of qubits supports a nontrivial logical operator (normalizer element outside stabilizer with support size at most 2)
lemmas.lean_skeleton: theorem no_pair_support : ∀ p : Fin 5 → Fin 4, p ∈ normalizer → (p.support.card ≤ 2) → p ∈ stabilizer := by decide

lemmas.statement: Each of the 10 triples supports a representative of each of the 3 nontrivial logical classes
lemmas.lean_skeleton: theorem triples_reconstruct : ∀ T : Finset (Fin 5), T.card = 3 → ∀ c : LogicalClass, c ≠ 0 → ∃ p ∈ normalizer, logicalClass p = c ∧ p.support ⊆ T := by sorry

lemmas.statement: Erasure of any two qubits is correctable, equivalent to no nontrivial logical operator supported on the pair
lemmas.lean_skeleton: theorem erasure_two : ∀ E : Finset (Fin 5), E.card = 2 → ∀ p ∈ normalizer, p.support ⊆ E → p ∈ stabilizer := by sorry

near_misses.claim: Some pair of qubits supports a nontrivial logical operator
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: The code has distance 3, so every nontrivial logical has weight at least 3

near_misses.claim: Erasure of three qubits is correctable
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: Triples support nontrivial logicals, so erasing a triple is uncorrectable
